description: Find The Conversation articles by keyword, topic, edition, article URL or publication date, and collect academic-written news metadata down to the full article text.

dateFrom.description: Earliest publication date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Archive mode uses it to choose yearly sitemaps; other modes filter returned records.
dateFrom.sectionDescription: Archive defaults to the current year when no dates are set. Detail level controls whether each article page is fetched.
dateFrom.title: Published from

detailLevel.description: Full fetches each article page and adds authors, roles, topics, section, DOI, word count, image caption and credit, update time and disclosure. Listing uses only the list page and returns title, URL, excerpt, byline/authors when present, published time when present and image fields when present; detail-only fields are omitted.
detailLevel.title: Detail level

edition.description: Regional edition for Latest, Search and Archive. Topic pages are global.
edition.sectionDescription: Regional editions are commissioned separately. Global combines the latest articles from all of them.
edition.title: Edition

includeArticleText.description: Add the cleaned article body as articleText. Requires full detail and increases dataset size.
includeArticleText.title: Include article text

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted articles. Archive and URL modes can return larger sets.
maxItems.title: Max articles

mode.description: Latest reads the newest articles in an edition. Search queries the site. Topic browses one topic. Article URLs scrapes exact links. Archive walks the yearly archive for a date range.
mode.title: What to scrape

searchQuery.description: Keyword or phrase for Search by keyword mode, for example climate or public health. Required in that mode; also filters the title and excerpt in Topic mode.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Used by Search and Topic modes. Leave a field blank when its mode is not selected.
searchQuery.title: Search keywords

section.description: Optional section for Latest mode, for example health, politics, environment or technology. Leave blank for the edition's main feed.
section.title: Section

topic.description: Topic slug or full topic URL, for example climate-change-27, health, or https://theconversation.com/topics/politics-245. Generic words such as science and health are resolved by the site. Also narrows Search by keyword results to one topic.
topic.title: Topic

urls.description: Exact The Conversation article links to scrape, for example https://theconversation.com/example-article-296812. Used by Scrape article URLs mode.
urls.title: Article URLs

title: The Conversation Scraper Input
